Evidence quote (Grewal et al., 2025, p. 702): "In the next decade, Gen AI will influence how marketers interact and communicate with customers, help create and deliver marketing content (text, images, and video)". DOI: 10.1007/s11747-024-01064-3.

Evidence quote (Cillo & Rubera, 2025, p. 684): "marketing is projected to be the most affected firm function by GenAI, which is forecast to enhance marketing productivity by up to 15%". DOI: 10.1007/s11747-024-01044-7.
Evidence quote (Farquhar et al., 2024, p. 625): LLMs often "hallucinate" false outputs and unsubstantiated answers; reliability controls remain necessary. DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07421-0.
Evidence quote (Verhoef et al., 2021, abstract): "we identify three stages of digital transformation: digitization, digitalization, and digital transformation." DOI: 10.1016/j.jbusres.2019.09.022.

Evidence quote (Hanelt et al., 2021, abstract): digital transformation is moving firms to "malleable organizational designs that enable continuous adaptation" and is embedded in digital business ecosystems. DOI: 10.1111/joms.12639.

Evidence quote (Enholm et al., 2022, abstract): organizations need a clearer understanding of "how AI technologies create business value" and of the "value-generating mechanisms," including enablers, inhibitors, and first- and second-order effects. DOI: 10.1007/s10796-021-10186-w.
Evidence quote (Doshi & Hauser, 2024, title finding): "Generative AI enhances individual creativity but reduces the collective diversity of novel content." DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.adn5290.

Evidence quote (Charmaz, 2014, p. 30): sensitizing concepts "offer ideas to pursue and questions to raise" rather than fixed prescriptions. This supports your use of sensitizing concepts in Section 2.5.

Evidence quote (Holmström, 2022, title-level evidence): "From AI to digital transformation: The AI readiness framework." This directly supports the claim that AI readiness bridges AI experimentation and broader digital transformation. DOI: 10.1016/j.bushor.2021.03.006.

(2008) title "Customer value: theory, research, and practice"; Sidorchuk (2015) title "The concept of 'value' in the theory of marketing"; Almquist et al. (2016) title "The elements of value." Evidence quote (Paschen et al., 2021, abstract): AI creates "new and exciting opportunities for value co-creation between economic actors" and examines exchanged "activities, roles and resources" (DOI: 10.1016/j.ausmj.2020.06.004).
